items.title: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models’ identity
items.summary: Called FlashProve, the system would let anyone check that an AI response really came from the model it claims to be from.

items.title: Data centers are turning to old jet engines as the wait for power grows
items.summary: The years-long wait for access to the grid and new turbines is causing data center builders to turn to an unusual, less-efficient and less environmentally friendly solution: once-discarded jet engines.

items.title: Ted Schlein’s Ballistic Ventures seeks $490M for new funds amid AI-driven cybersecurity boom
items.summary: Cybersecurity-focused Ballistic Ventures is seeking to raise $360 million for a new flagship fund and another $130 million for a separate investment vehicle.

items.title: مردم برای طلاق از هوش مصنوعی مشاوره می‌گیرند و وکلا را به ستوه آورده‌اند

items.title: پایان انحصار گوگل نزدیک است؟ آمار خیره‌کننده از محبوبیت ChatGPT

items.title: یا هوش مصنوعی یا هیچ؛ شرط تازه‌ گوگل برای مدارس!
